title: Why is a copy needed?
captions: The lesson supplies a complete starter program. This walkthrough explains how its GPU result reaches the Console.
speech: The lesson supplies a complete starter program. This walkthrough explains how its GPU result reaches the Console.

title: Why is a copy needed?
captions: The GPU writes 42.0, but the CPU prints it. What connects those two steps?
speech: The GPU writes forty-two point zero, but the CPU prints it. What connects those two steps?

title: The kernel runs on the GPU
captions: hello is a kernel: a function that runs on the GPU. Its body writes 42.0 into output[0].
speech: Hello is a kernel: a function that runs on the GPU. Its body writes forty-two point zero into output at index zero.

title: The starter prepares GPU storage
captions: The supplied setup reserves space for that value in GPU memory. You can leave this setup unchanged.
speech: The supplied setup reserves space for that value in GPU memory. You can leave this setup unchanged.

title: The CPU launches hello
captions: In main, the CPU launches hello. The two ones request one block containing one thread.
speech: In main, the CPU launches hello. The two ones request one block containing one thread.

title: One thread executes on an SM
captions: A thread is one execution of the kernel. An SM, or streaming multiprocessor, is GPU hardware that executes its instructions.
speech: A thread is one execution of the kernel. An SM, or streaming multiprocessor, is GPU hardware that executes its instructions.

title: The thread writes GPU memory
captions: The thread writes 42.0 into output[0] in GPU memory.
speech: The thread writes forty-two point zero into output at index zero in GPU memory.

title: The CPU has a separate variable
captions: The program also has a CPU variable named value. main initialises it to 0.0.
speech: The program also has a CPU variable named value. Main initialises it to zero point zero.

title: Pause before the copy
captions: Suppose the GPU write and the CPU initialisation have both finished. The copy has not started.
speech: Suppose the GPU write and the CPU initialisation have both finished. The copy has not started.

title: Pause before the copy
captions: Pause here. Is the CPU variable value still 0.0, or has the GPU write changed it to 42.0?
speech: Pause here. Is the CPU variable value still zero point zero, or has the GPU write changed it to forty-two point zero?

title: The GPU write did not change value
captions: value is still 0.0. The GPU wrote to output[0], a different location in GPU memory.
speech: Value is still zero point zero. The GPU wrote to output at index zero, a different location in GPU memory.

title: The copy transfers the result
captions: The cudaMemcpy call copies the GPU result into value in CPU memory.
speech: The CUDA memory copy call copies the GPU result into value in CPU memory.

title: The copy completes before printing
captions: For this call, main waits for the copy to complete before continuing. value now holds 42.0.
speech: For this call, main waits for the copy to complete before continuing. Value now holds forty-two point zero.

title: The CPU prints its copy
captions: The CPU reads value and prints 42.0 in Console. The kernel itself did not print that line.
speech: The CPU reads value and prints forty-two point zero in Console. The kernel itself did not print that line.

title: Execution, storage and transfer
captions: The SM executes the thread. GPU memory holds its result. The copy makes that result available to CPU code.
speech: The SM executes the thread. GPU memory holds its result. The copy makes that result available to CPU code.
